```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ClientConfig {
    /// Local UDP bind address
    pub local_udp: SocketAddr,
    /// List of domains to use for DNS queries
    pub domains: Vec<String>,
    /// List of DNS resolver addresses
    pub resolvers: Vec<SocketAddr>,
    /// Maximum subdomain length (default: 64)
    pub max_subdomain_length: usize,
    /// Enable resolver rotation
    pub rotate_resolvers: bool,
    /// Randomize local UDP port
    pub randomize_local_port: bool,
}

impl Default for ClientConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            local_udp: "127.0.0.1:5353".parse().unwrap(),
            domains: vec!["example.com".to_string()],
            resolvers: vec!["8.8.8.8:53".parse().unwrap()],
            max_subdomain_length: 64,
            rotate_resolvers: true,
            randomize_local_port: false,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ServerConfig {
    /// DNS server bind address
    pub dns_bind: SocketAddr,
    /// Target UDP address to forward packets to
    pub target_udp: Option<SocketAddr>,
    /// List of domains to listen for
    pub domains: Vec<String>,
    /// Maximum subdomain length (default: 64)
    pub max_subdomain_length: usize,
    /// Randomize DNS server port
    pub randomize_dns_port: bool,
}

impl Default for ServerConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            dns_bind: "0.0.0.0:53".parse().unwrap(),
            target_udp: None,
            domains: vec!["example.com".to_string()],
            max_subdomain_length: 64,
            randomize_dns_port: false,
        }
    }
}

pub fn load_client_config(path: Option<PathBuf>) -> anyhow::Result<ClientConfig> {
    if let Some(p) = path {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(p)?;
        Ok(serde_json::from_str(&content)?)
    } else {
        Ok(ClientConfig::default())
    }
}

pub fn load_server_config(path: Option<PathBuf>) -> anyhow::Result<ServerConfig> {
    if let Some(p) = path {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(p)?;
        Ok(serde_json::from_str(&content)?)
    } else {
        Ok(ServerConfig::default())
    }
}
```

```rust
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

const PACKET_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
const MAX_PACKET_SIZE: usize = 65507; // Max UDP packet size

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TunnelPacket {
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub source: SocketAddr,
    pub destination: SocketAddr,
    pub packet_id: u16,
    pub fragment_id: u8,
    pub total_fragments: u8,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct PacketReassembler {
    fragments: HashMap<(SocketAddr, SocketAddr, u16), HashMap<u8, (Vec<u8>, Instant)>>,
}

impl PacketReassembler {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            fragments: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn add_fragment(&mut self, packet: TunnelPacket) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        let key = (packet.source, packet.destination, packet.packet_id);
        
        // Clean up old fragments
        self.cleanup();

        let fragment_map = self.fragments.entry(key).or_insert_with(HashMap::new);
        fragment_map.insert(packet.fragment_id, (packet.data, Instant::now()));

        // Check if we have all fragments
        if fragment_map.len() == packet.total_fragments as usize {
            let mut fragments: Vec<_> = fragment_map.iter().collect();
            fragments.sort_by_key(|(id, _)| **id);
            
            let mut reassembled = Vec::new();
            for (_, (data, _)) in fragments {
                reassembled.extend_from_slice(data);
            }

            self.fragments.remove(&key);
            Some(reassembled)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn cleanup(&mut self) {
        let now = Instant::now();
        self.fragments.retain(|_, fragments| {
            fragments.retain(|_, (_, time)| now.duration_since(*time) < PACKET_TIMEOUT);
            !fragments.is_empty()
        });
    }
}

impl Default for PacketReassembler {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

pub fn fragment_packet(data: &[u8], max_chunk_size: usize) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut fragments = Vec::new();
    let mut offset = 0;
    
    while offset < data.len() {
        let chunk_size = (data.len() - offset).min(max_chunk_size);
        fragments.push(data[offset..offset + chunk_size].to_vec());
        offset += chunk_size;
    }
    
    fragments
}
```

```rust
use crate::packet::TunnelPacket;
use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::{Message, MessageType, OpCode, ResponseCode},
    rr::{DNSClass, Name, RData, Record, RecordType},
    serialize::binary::{BinEncodable, BinEncoder},
};
use rand::Rng;
use std::net::SocketAddr;

pub struct DnsCodec {
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    max_payload_per_query: usize,
}

impl DnsCodec {
    pub fn new(max_subdomain_length: usize) -> Self {
        // Reserve space for domain name, base64 overhead, and DNS record structure
        // Base64 encoding increases size by ~33%, so we calculate accordingly
        let max_payload = ((max_subdomain_length as f64 * 0.75) as usize).max(32);
        
        Self {
            max_subdomain_length,
            max_payload_per_query: max_payload,
        }
    }

    /// Encode UDP packet data into DNS query
    pub fn encode_to_dns_query(
        &self,
        data: &[u8],
        domain: &str,
        packet_id: u16,
        fragment_id: u8,
        total_fragments: u8,
    ) -> Result<Message> {
        // Create packet header: packet_id (2 bytes) + fragment_id (1) + total_fragments (1) + data
        let mut packet_data = Vec::with_capacity(4 + data.len());
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(&packet_id.to_be_bytes());
        packet_data.push(fragment_id);
        packet_data.push(total_fragments);
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(data);

        // Encode to base64
        let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(&packet_data);
        
        // Ensure subdomain doesn't exceed max length
        let subdomain = if encoded.len() > self.max_subdomain_length {
            &encoded[..self.max_subdomain_length]
        } else {
            &encoded
        };

        // Create DNS query
        let mut message = Message::new();
        message.set_id(rand::thread_rng().gen());
        message.set_message_type(MessageType::Query);
        message.set_op_code(OpCode::Query);
        message.set_recursion_desired(true);

        // Build query name: <subdomain>.<domain>
        let query_name = format!("{}.{}", subdomain, domain);
        let name = Name::from_ascii(&query_name)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to create DNS name: {}", e))?;

        // Add question with any record type (we'll use TXT as default, but accept any)
        message.add_query(hickory_dns::rr::Question::new(
            name,
            RecordType::TXT,
            DNSClass::IN,
        ));

        Ok(message)
    }

    /// Decode DNS query to extract UDP packet data
    pub fn decode_from_dns_query(&self, message: &Message, expected_domains: &[String]) -> Result<Option<TunnelPacket>> {
        if message.queries().is_empty() {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let query = &message.queries()[0];
        let query_name = query.name().to_ascii();
        
        // Check if query matches any of our expected domains
        let domain_match = expected_domains.iter().any(|domain| {
            query_name.ends_with(domain) && query_name.len() > domain.len() + 1
        });

        if !domain_match {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // Extract subdomain (everything before the domain)
        let domain = expected_domains.iter()
            .find(|d| query_name.ends_with(d))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Domain not found"))?;
        
        let subdomain_part = query_name
            .strip_suffix(&format!(".{}", domain))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Invalid query format"))?;

        // Decode base64
        let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
            .decode(subdomain_part)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to decode base64: {}", e))?;

        if decoded.len() < 4 {
            return Err(anyhow!("Packet too short"));
        }

        // Extract packet metadata
        let packet_id = u16::from_be_bytes([decoded[0], decoded[1]]);
        let fragment_id = decoded[2];
        let total_fragments = decoded[3];
        let data = decoded[4..].to_vec();

        // We don't have source/dest in DNS query, so we'll use placeholder
        // The actual source will be set by the server based on the DNS query source
        Ok(Some(TunnelPacket {
            data,
            source: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(), // Will be set by server
            destination: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(), // Will be set by server
            packet_id,
            fragment_id,
            total_fragments,
        }))
    }

    /// Encode UDP response data into DNS response
    pub fn encode_to_dns_response(
        &self,
        data: &[u8],
        domain: &str,
        packet_id: u16,
        fragment_id: u8,
        total_fragments: u8,
        original_query_id: u16,
    ) -> Result<Message> {
        // Create packet header
        let mut packet_data = Vec::with_capacity(4 + data.len());
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(&packet_id.to_be_bytes());
        packet_data.push(fragment_id);
        packet_data.push(total_fragments);
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(data);

        // Encode to base64
        let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(&packet_data);
        
        // Ensure subdomain doesn't exceed max length
        let subdomain = if encoded.len() > self.max_subdomain_length {
            &encoded[..self.max_subdomain_length]
        } else {
            &encoded
        };

        // Create DNS response
        let mut message = Message::new();
        message.set_id(original_query_id);
        message.set_message_type(MessageType::Response);
        message.set_op_code(OpCode::Query);
        message.set_response_code(ResponseCode::NoError);
        message.set_recursion_desired(true);

        // Build response name
        let response_name = format!("{}.{}", subdomain, domain);
        let name = Name::from_ascii(&response_name)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to create DNS name: {}", e))?;

        // Add TXT record with the data
        let record = Record::from_rdata(
            name,
            0, // TTL
            RData::TXT(hickory_dns::rr::rdata::TXT::new(vec![subdomain.as_bytes().to_vec()])),
        );
        message.add_answer(record);

        Ok(message)
    }

    /// Decode DNS response to extract UDP packet data
    pub fn decode_from_dns_response(&self, message: &Message, expected_domains: &[String]) -> Result<Option<TunnelPacket>> {
        if message.answers().is_empty() {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let answer = &message.answers()[0];
        let answer_name = answer.name().to_ascii();
        
        // Check if answer matches any of our expected domains
        let domain_match = expected_domains.iter().any(|domain| {
            answer_name.ends_with(domain) && answer_name.len() > domain.len() + 1
        });

        if !domain_match {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // Extract subdomain
        let domain = expected_domains.iter()
            .find(|d| answer_name.ends_with(d))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Domain not found"))?;
        
        let subdomain_part = answer_name
            .strip_suffix(&format!(".{}", domain))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Invalid answer format"))?;

        // Decode base64
        let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
            .decode(subdomain_part)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to decode base64: {}", e))?;

        if decoded.len() < 4 {
            return Err(anyhow!("Packet too short"));
        }

        // Extract packet metadata
        let packet_id = u16::from_be_bytes([decoded[0], decoded[1]]);
        let fragment_id = decoded[2];
        let total_fragments = decoded[3];
        let data = decoded[4..].to_vec();

        Ok(Some(TunnelPacket {
            data,
            source: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(),
            destination: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(),
            packet_id,
            fragment_id,
            total_fragments,
        }))
    }

    pub fn max_payload_per_query(&self) -> usize {
        self.max_payload_per_query
    }
}
```

```rust
use rand::Rng;
use std::net::{SocketAddr, UdpSocket};

pub fn get_random_port() -> u16 {
    let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
    // Use ports in the range 49152-65535 (dynamic/private ports)
    rng.gen_range(49152..=65535)
}

pub fn bind_random_port(addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<UdpSocket> {
    let mut attempts = 0;
    loop {
        let port = get_random_port();
        let bind_addr = format!("{}:{}", addr, port);
        
        match UdpSocket::bind(&bind_addr) {
            Ok(socket) => return Ok(socket),
            Err(_) => {
                attempts += 1;
                if attempts > 100 {
                    return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                        std::io::ErrorKind::AddrInUse,
                        "Failed to find available port after 100 attempts",
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn rotate_resolver<T>(resolvers: &[T], index: usize) -> &T {
    &resolvers[index % resolvers.len()]
}
```

Implementing the client and server binaries:


```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::Parser;
use dns_tunnel::{
    config::{load_client_config, ClientConfig},
    dns_codec::DnsCodec,
    packet::{fragment_packet, PacketReassembler, TunnelPacket},
    utils::{bind_random_port, get_random_port, rotate_resolver},
};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::Message,
    serialize::binary::{BinDecodable, BinDecoder},
};
use log::{debug, error, info, warn};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::net::UdpSocket;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "dns-tunnel-client")]
#[command(about = "DNS Tunnel Client (Iran side)")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    config: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    local_addr: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    local_port: Option<u16>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    domains: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    resolvers: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(long, default_value = "64")]
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    #[arg(long)]
    no_rotate_resolvers: bool,
    #[arg(long)]
    randomize_local_port: bool,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();

    let args = Args::parse();
    
    let mut config = if let Some(config_path) = args.config {
        load_client_config(Some(config_path.into()))?
    } else {
        ClientConfig::default()
    };

    // Override with CLI args
    if !args.domains.is_empty() {
        config.domains = args.domains;
    }
    if !args.resolvers.is_empty() {
        config.resolvers = args.resolvers
            .iter()
            .map(|r| r.parse())
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .context("Invalid resolver address")?;
    }
    if args.max_subdomain_length > 0 {
        config.max_subdomain_length = args.max_subdomain_length;
    }
    config.rotate_resolvers = !args.no_rotate_resolvers;
    config.randomize_local_port = args.randomize_local_port;

    // Set local UDP port
    let local_port = if config.randomize_local_port {
        get_random_port()
    } else {
        args.local_port.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            config.local_udp.port()
        })
    };
    let local_udp = format!("{}:{}", args.local_addr, local_port)
        .parse()
        .context("Invalid local UDP address")?;

    info!("Starting DNS Tunnel Client");
    info!("Local UDP: {}", local_udp);
    info!("Domains: {:?}", config.domains);
    info!("Resolvers: {:?}", config.resolvers);
    info!("Max subdomain length: {}", config.max_subdomain_length);
    info!("Resolver rotation: {}", config.rotate_resolvers);

    if config.domains.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one domain must be specified");
    }
    if config.resolvers.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one resolver must be specified");
    }

    // Bind local UDP socket
    let udp_socket = UdpSocket::bind(&local_udp)
        .await
        .context("Failed to bind local UDP socket")?;
    info!("Bound to local UDP: {}", local_udp);

    let codec = Arc::new(DnsCodec::new(config.max_subdomain_length));
    let reassembler = Arc::new(Mutex::new(PacketReassembler::new()));
    let pending_requests: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, (SocketAddr, u16)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    let resolver_index = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0usize));

    // Spawn task to receive DNS responses
    let dns_response_task = {
        let codec = codec.clone();
        let reassembler = reassembler.clone();
        let pending_requests = pending_requests.clone();
        let config = config.clone();
        
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            // Create a UDP socket to receive DNS responses
            // We'll use a random port for receiving DNS responses
            let dns_socket = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")
                .await
                .expect("Failed to bind DNS response socket");
            
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65535];
            
            loop {
                match dns_socket.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
                    Ok((len, _src)) => {
                        let response_data = &buf[..len];
                        match Message::from_bytes(response_data) {
                            Ok(message) => {
                                match codec.decode_from_dns_response(&message, &config.domains) {
                                    Ok(Some(packet)) => {
                                        let mut reass = reassembler.lock().await;
                                        if let Some(reassembled_data) = reass.add_fragment(packet.clone()) {
                                            // Find the original source
                                            let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                                            if let Some((original_source, _)) = pending.remove(&packet.packet_id) {
                                                // Forward reassembled packet to original source
                                                if let Err(e) = dns_socket.send_to(&reassembled_data, original_source).await {
                                                    error!("Failed to send reassembled packet: {}", e);
                                                } else {
                                                    debug!("Sent reassembled packet to {}", original_source);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Ok(None) => {
                                        debug!("DNS response doesn't contain tunnel data");
                                    }
                                    Err(e) => {
                                        warn!("Failed to decode DNS response: {}", e);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                warn!("Failed to parse DNS response: {}", e);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        error!("Error receiving DNS response: {}", e);
                        sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                    }
                }
            }
        })
    });

    // Main loop: receive UDP packets and send as DNS queries
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65507];
    let mut packet_id_counter = 0u16;
    
    loop {
        match udp_socket.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
            Ok((len, source)) => {
                let data = &buf[..len];
                debug!("Received {} bytes from {}", len, source);

                // Generate packet ID
                let packet_id = packet_id_counter;
                packet_id_counter = packet_id_counter.wrapping_add(1);

                // Store pending request
                {
                    let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                    pending.insert(packet_id, (source, 0));
                }

                // Fragment packet if needed
                let max_chunk = codec.max_payload_per_query();
                let fragments = fragment_packet(data, max_chunk);
                let total_fragments = fragments.len() as u8;

                info!("Fragmenting packet {} into {} fragments", packet_id, total_fragments);

                // Select domain and resolver
                let domain = &config.domains[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.domains.len())];
                let resolver = if config.rotate_resolvers {
                    let mut idx = resolver_index.lock().await;
                    *idx = (*idx + 1) % config.resolvers.len();
                    rotate_resolver(&config.resolvers, *idx)
                } else {
                    &config.resolvers[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.resolvers.len())]
                };

                // Send each fragment as DNS query
                for (fragment_id, fragment_data) in fragments.iter().enumerate() {
                    match codec.encode_to_dns_query(
                        fragment_data,
                        domain,
                        packet_id,
                        fragment_id as u8,
                        total_fragments,
                    ) {
                        Ok(dns_query) => {
                            let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                            if let Err(e) = dns_query.emit(&mut encoder) {
                                error!("Failed to encode DNS query: {}", e);
                                continue;
                            }

                            let query_bytes = encoder.into_bytes();
                            
                            // Send to multiple resolvers (spam)
                            for resolver in &config.resolvers {
                                if let Err(e) = udp_socket.send_to(&query_bytes, resolver).await {
                                    warn!("Failed to send DNS query to {}: {}", resolver, e);
                                } else {
                                    debug!("Sent DNS query fragment {}/{} to {}", 
                                           fragment_id + 1, total_fragments, resolver);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            error!("Failed to encode packet to DNS: {}", e);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Error receiving UDP packet: {}", e);
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
            }
        }
    }

    // This will never be reached, but keep the task alive
    dns_response_task.await?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::Parser;
use dns_tunnel::{
    config::{load_server_config, ServerConfig},
    dns_codec::DnsCodec,
    packet::{fragment_packet, PacketReassembler, TunnelPacket},
    utils::{bind_random_port, get_random_port},
};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::Message,
    serialize::binary::{BinDecodable, BinDecoder, BinEncodable, BinEncoder},
};
use log::{debug, error, info, warn};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::net::UdpSocket;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "dns-tunnel-server")]
#[command(about = "DNS Tunnel Server (VPS side)")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    config: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "0.0.0.0")]
    dns_bind_addr: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    dns_port: Option<u16>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    target_udp: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    domains: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(long, default_value = "64")]
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    #[arg(long)]
    randomize_dns_port: bool,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();

    let args = Args::parse();
    
    let mut config = if let Some(config_path) = args.config {
        load_server_config(Some(config_path.into()))?
    } else {
        ServerConfig::default()
    };

    // Override with CLI args
    if !args.domains.is_empty() {
        config.domains = args.domains;
    }
    if args.max_subdomain_length > 0 {
        config.max_subdomain_length = args.max_subdomain_length;
    }
    config.randomize_dns_port = args.randomize_dns_port;

    // Set DNS bind port
    let dns_port = if config.randomize_dns_port {
        get_random_port()
    } else {
        args.dns_port.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            config.dns_bind.port()
        })
    };
    let dns_bind = format!("{}:{}", args.dns_bind_addr, dns_port)
        .parse()
        .context("Invalid DNS bind address")?;

    // Set target UDP
    let target_udp = if let Some(target) = args.target_udp {
        Some(target.parse().context("Invalid target UDP address")?)
    } else {
        config.target_udp
    };

    info!("Starting DNS Tunnel Server");
    info!("DNS bind: {}", dns_bind);
    info!("Target UDP: {:?}", target_udp);
    info!("Domains: {:?}", config.domains);
    info!("Max subdomain length: {}", config.max_subdomain_length);

    if config.domains.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one domain must be specified");
    }

    // Bind DNS socket
    let dns_socket = UdpSocket::bind(&dns_bind)
        .await
        .context("Failed to bind DNS socket")?;
    info!("Bound to DNS: {}", dns_bind);

    // Create target UDP socket if specified
    let target_socket = if let Some(target) = target_udp {
        Some(UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")
            .await
            .context("Failed to bind target UDP socket")?)
    } else {
        None
    };

    let codec = Arc::new(DnsCodec::new(config.max_subdomain_length));
    let reassembler = Arc::new(Mutex::new(PacketReassembler::new()));
    let pending_requests: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, (SocketAddr, u16)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));

    // Spawn task to receive UDP responses from target
    if let Some(ref target_sock) = target_socket {
        if let Some(ref target_addr) = config.target_udp {
            let target_sock = target_sock.clone();
            let target_addr = *target_addr;
            let codec = codec.clone();
            let config = config.clone();
            let dns_socket = dns_socket.clone();
            let pending_requests = pending_requests.clone();
            
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65507];
                
                loop {
                    match target_sock.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
                        Ok((len, _src)) => {
                            let data = &buf[..len];
                            debug!("Received {} bytes from target", len);

                            // Find the original DNS query source
                            let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                            
                            // We need to match this response to a request
                            // For simplicity, we'll use the first pending request
                            // In a real implementation, you'd want better matching
                            if let Some((dns_source, query_id)) = pending.values().next().copied() {
                                // Fragment and encode as DNS responses
                                let max_chunk = codec.max_payload_per_query();
                                let fragments = fragment_packet(data, max_chunk);
                                let total_fragments = fragments.len() as u8;
                                
                                let packet_id = rand::thread_rng().gen::<u16>();
                                let domain = &config.domains[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.domains.len())];

                                for (fragment_id, fragment_data) in fragments.iter().enumerate() {
                                    match codec.encode_to_dns_response(
                                        fragment_data,
                                        domain,
                                        packet_id,
                                        fragment_id as u8,
                                        total_fragments,
                                        query_id,
                                    ) {
                                        Ok(dns_response) => {
                                            let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                                            if let Err(e) = dns_response.emit(&mut encoder) {
                                                error!("Failed to encode DNS response: {}", e);
                                                continue;
                                            }

                                            let response_bytes = encoder.into_bytes();
                                            
                                            if let Err(e) = dns_socket.send_to(&response_bytes, dns_source).await {
                                                warn!("Failed to send DNS response: {}", e);
                                            } else {
                                                debug!("Sent DNS response fragment {}/{} to {}", 
                                                       fragment_id + 1, total_fragments, dns_source);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Err(e) => {
                                            error!("Failed to encode response to DNS: {}", e);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            error!("Error receiving from target: {}", e);
                            sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Main loop: receive DNS queries and forward as UDP
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65535];
    
    loop {
        match dns_socket.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
            Ok((len, dns_source)) => {
                let query_data = &buf[..len];
                
                match Message::from_bytes(query_data) {
                    Ok(message) => {
                        match codec.decode_from_dns_query(&message, &config.domains) {
                            Ok(Some(mut packet)) => {
                                // Set the actual source from DNS query
                                packet.source = dns_source;
                                
                                debug!("Decoded DNS query from {}: packet_id={}, fragment={}/{}", 
                                       dns_source, packet.packet_id, packet.fragment_id + 1, packet.total_fragments);

                                // Store pending request
                                {
                                    let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                                    pending.insert(packet.packet_id, (dns_source, message.id()));
                                }

                                // Reassemble packet
                                let mut reass = reassembler.lock().await;
                                if let Some(reassembled_data) = reass.add_fragment(packet.clone()) {
                                    info!("Reassembled packet {} ({} bytes)", packet.packet_id, reassembled_data.len());

                                    // Forward to target UDP
                                    if let Some(ref target_sock) = target_socket {
                                        if let Some(target_addr) = config.target_udp {
                                            if let Err(e) = target_sock.send_to(&reassembled_data, target_addr).await {
                                                error!("Failed to forward packet to target: {}", e);
                                            } else {
                                                info!("Forwarded packet to {}", target_addr);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        // No target specified, just log
                                        debug!("No target UDP configured, packet would be forwarded here");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            Ok(None) => {
                                // Not a tunnel packet, send empty response
                                let mut response = Message::new();
                                response.set_id(message.id());
                                response.set_message_type(hickory_dns::op::MessageType::Response);
                                response.set_response_code(hickory_dns::rr::RCode::NXDomain);
                                
                                let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                                if response.emit(&mut encoder).is_ok() {
                                    let _ = dns_socket.send_to(&encoder.into_bytes(), dns_source).await;
                                }
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                warn!("Failed to decode DNS query: {}", e);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        warn!("Failed to parse DNS query: {}", e);
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Error receiving DNS query: {}", e);
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
use crate::packet::TunnelPacket;
use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::{Message, MessageType, OpCode, ResponseCode},
    rr::{DNSClass, Name, RData, Record, RecordType},
    serialize::binary::{BinEncodable, BinEncoder},
};
use rand::Rng;
use std::net::SocketAddr;

pub struct DnsCodec {
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    max_payload_per_query: usize,
}

impl DnsCodec {
    pub fn new(max_subdomain_length: usize) -> Self {
        // Reserve space for domain name, base64 overhead, and DNS record structure
        // Base64 encoding increases size by ~33%, so we calculate accordingly
        let max_payload = ((max_subdomain_length as f64 * 0.75) as usize).max(32);
        
        Self {
            max_subdomain_length,
            max_payload_per_query: max_payload,
        }
    }

    /// Encode UDP packet data into DNS query
    pub fn encode_to_dns_query(
        &self,
        data: &[u8],
        domain: &str,
        packet_id: u16,
        fragment_id: u8,
        total_fragments: u8,
    ) -> Result<Message> {
        // Create packet header: packet_id (2 bytes) + fragment_id (1) + total_fragments (1) + data
        let mut packet_data = Vec::with_capacity(4 + data.len());
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(&packet_id.to_be_bytes());
        packet_data.push(fragment_id);
        packet_data.push(total_fragments);
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(data);

        // Encode to base64 (URL-safe, no padding)
        let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
            .encode(&packet_data);
        
        // Ensure subdomain doesn't exceed max length
        let subdomain = if encoded.len() > self.max_subdomain_length {
            &encoded[..self.max_subdomain_length]
        } else {
            &encoded
        };

        // Create DNS query
        let mut message = Message::new();
        message.set_id(rand::thread_rng().gen());
        message.set_message_type(MessageType::Query);
        message.set_op_code(OpCode::Query);
        message.set_recursion_desired(true);

        // Build query name: <subdomain>.<domain>
        let query_name = format!("{}.{}", subdomain, domain);
        let name = Name::from_ascii(&query_name)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to create DNS name: {}", e))?;

        // Add question with any record type (we'll use TXT as default, but accept any)
        message.add_query(hickory_dns::rr::Question::new(
            name,
            RecordType::TXT,
            DNSClass::IN,
        ));

        Ok(message)
    }

    /// Decode DNS query to extract UDP packet data
    pub fn decode_from_dns_query(&self, message: &Message, expected_domains: &[String]) -> Result<Option<TunnelPacket>> {
        if message.queries().is_empty() {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let query = &message.queries()[0];
        let query_name = query.name().to_ascii();
        
        // Check if query matches any of our expected domains
        let domain_match = expected_domains.iter().any(|domain| {
            query_name.ends_with(domain) && query_name.len() > domain.len() + 1
        });

        if !domain_match {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // Extract subdomain (everything before the domain)
        let domain = expected_domains.iter()
            .find(|d| query_name.ends_with(d))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Domain not found"))?;
        
        let subdomain_part = query_name
            .strip_suffix(&format!(".{}", domain))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Invalid query format"))?;

        // Decode base64
        let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
            .decode(subdomain_part)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to decode base64: {}", e))?;

        if decoded.len() < 4 {
            return Err(anyhow!("Packet too short"));
        }

        // Extract packet metadata
        let packet_id = u16::from_be_bytes([decoded[0], decoded[1]]);
        let fragment_id = decoded[2];
        let total_fragments = decoded[3];
        let data = decoded[4..].to_vec();

        // We don't have source/dest in DNS query, so we'll use placeholder
        // The actual source will be set by the server based on the DNS query source
        Ok(Some(TunnelPacket {
            data,
            source: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(), // Will be set by server
            destination: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(), // Will be set by server
            packet_id,
            fragment_id,
            total_fragments,
        }))
    }

    /// Encode UDP response data into DNS response
    pub fn encode_to_dns_response(
        &self,
        data: &[u8],
        domain: &str,
        packet_id: u16,
        fragment_id: u8,
        total_fragments: u8,
        original_query_id: u16,
    ) -> Result<Message> {
        // Create packet header
        let mut packet_data = Vec::with_capacity(4 + data.len());
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(&packet_id.to_be_bytes());
        packet_data.push(fragment_id);
        packet_data.push(total_fragments);
        packet_data.extend_from_slice(data);

        // Encode to base64 (URL-safe, no padding)
        let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
            .encode(&packet_data);
        
        // Ensure subdomain doesn't exceed max length
        let subdomain = if encoded.len() > self.max_subdomain_length {
            &encoded[..self.max_subdomain_length]
        } else {
            &encoded
        };

        // Create DNS response
        let mut message = Message::new();
        message.set_id(original_query_id);
        message.set_message_type(MessageType::Response);
        message.set_op_code(OpCode::Query);
        message.set_response_code(ResponseCode::NoError);
        message.set_recursion_desired(true);

        // Build response name
        let response_name = format!("{}.{}", subdomain, domain);
        let name = Name::from_ascii(&response_name)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to create DNS name: {}", e))?;

        // Add TXT record with the data
        let record = Record::from_rdata(
            name,
            0, // TTL
            RData::TXT(hickory_dns::rr::rdata::TXT::new(vec![subdomain.as_bytes().to_vec()])),
        );
        message.add_answer(record);

        Ok(message)
    }

    /// Decode DNS response to extract UDP packet data
    pub fn decode_from_dns_response(&self, message: &Message, expected_domains: &[String]) -> Result<Option<TunnelPacket>> {
        if message.answers().is_empty() {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let answer = &message.answers()[0];
        let answer_name = answer.name().to_ascii();
        
        // Check if answer matches any of our expected domains
        let domain_match = expected_domains.iter().any(|domain| {
            answer_name.ends_with(domain) && answer_name.len() > domain.len() + 1
        });

        if !domain_match {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // Extract subdomain
        let domain = expected_domains.iter()
            .find(|d| answer_name.ends_with(d))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Domain not found"))?;
        
        let subdomain_part = answer_name
            .strip_suffix(&format!(".{}", domain))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Invalid answer format"))?;

        // Decode base64
        let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
            .decode(subdomain_part)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to decode base64: {}", e))?;

        if decoded.len() < 4 {
            return Err(anyhow!("Packet too short"));
        }

        // Extract packet metadata
        let packet_id = u16::from_be_bytes([decoded[0], decoded[1]]);
        let fragment_id = decoded[2];
        let total_fragments = decoded[3];
        let data = decoded[4..].to_vec();

        Ok(Some(TunnelPacket {
            data,
            source: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(),
            destination: "0.0.0.0:0".parse().unwrap(),
            packet_id,
            fragment_id,
            total_fragments,
        }))
    }

    pub fn max_payload_per_query(&self) -> usize {
        self.max_payload_per_query
    }
}
```

Fixing the client to use the same socket for sending and receiving, and improving the server's packet matching:


```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::Parser;
use dns_tunnel::{
    config::{load_client_config, ClientConfig},
    dns_codec::DnsCodec,
    packet::{fragment_packet, PacketReassembler, TunnelPacket},
    utils::{bind_random_port, get_random_port, rotate_resolver},
};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::Message,
    serialize::binary::{BinDecodable, BinDecoder},
};
use log::{debug, error, info, warn};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::net::UdpSocket;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "dns-tunnel-client")]
#[command(about = "DNS Tunnel Client (Iran side)")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    config: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    local_addr: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    local_port: Option<u16>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    domains: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    resolvers: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(long, default_value = "64")]
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    #[arg(long)]
    no_rotate_resolvers: bool,
    #[arg(long)]
    randomize_local_port: bool,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();

    let args = Args::parse();
    
    let mut config = if let Some(config_path) = args.config {
        load_client_config(Some(config_path.into()))?
    } else {
        ClientConfig::default()
    };

    // Override with CLI args
    if !args.domains.is_empty() {
        config.domains = args.domains;
    }
    if !args.resolvers.is_empty() {
        config.resolvers = args.resolvers
            .iter()
            .map(|r| r.parse())
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .context("Invalid resolver address")?;
    }
    if args.max_subdomain_length > 0 {
        config.max_subdomain_length = args.max_subdomain_length;
    }
    config.rotate_resolvers = !args.no_rotate_resolvers;
    config.randomize_local_port = args.randomize_local_port;

    // Set local UDP port
    let local_port = if config.randomize_local_port {
        get_random_port()
    } else {
        args.local_port.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            config.local_udp.port()
        })
    };
    let local_udp = format!("{}:{}", args.local_addr, local_port)
        .parse()
        .context("Invalid local UDP address")?;

    info!("Starting DNS Tunnel Client");
    info!("Local UDP: {}", local_udp);
    info!("Domains: {:?}", config.domains);
    info!("Resolvers: {:?}", config.resolvers);
    info!("Max subdomain length: {}", config.max_subdomain_length);
    info!("Resolver rotation: {}", config.rotate_resolvers);

    if config.domains.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one domain must be specified");
    }
    if config.resolvers.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one resolver must be specified");
    }

    // Bind local UDP socket
    let udp_socket = UdpSocket::bind(&local_udp)
        .await
        .context("Failed to bind local UDP socket")?;
    info!("Bound to local UDP: {}", local_udp);

    let codec = Arc::new(DnsCodec::new(config.max_subdomain_length));
    let reassembler = Arc::new(Mutex::new(PacketReassembler::new()));
    let pending_requests: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, (SocketAddr, u16)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    let resolver_index = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0usize));

    // Spawn task to receive DNS responses on the same socket
    let udp_socket_for_dns = udp_socket.clone();
    let dns_response_task = {
        let codec = codec.clone();
        let reassembler = reassembler.clone();
        let pending_requests = pending_requests.clone();
        let config = config.clone();
        
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65535];
            
            loop {
                match udp_socket_for_dns.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
                    Ok((len, src)) => {
                        let response_data = &buf[..len];
                        
                        // Try to parse as DNS response first
                        match Message::from_bytes(response_data) {
                            Ok(message) => {
                                match codec.decode_from_dns_response(&message, &config.domains) {
                                    Ok(Some(packet)) => {
                                        let mut reass = reassembler.lock().await;
                                        if let Some(reassembled_data) = reass.add_fragment(packet.clone()) {
                                            // Find the original source
                                            let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                                            if let Some((original_source, _)) = pending.remove(&packet.packet_id) {
                                                // Forward reassembled packet to original source
                                                if let Err(e) = udp_socket_for_dns.send_to(&reassembled_data, original_source).await {
                                                    error!("Failed to send reassembled packet: {}", e);
                                                } else {
                                                    debug!("Sent reassembled packet to {}", original_source);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Ok(None) => {
                                        // Not a tunnel DNS response, ignore
                                    }
                                    Err(e) => {
                                        // Not a tunnel packet, might be regular DNS or UDP
                                        debug!("Not a tunnel DNS response: {}", e);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            Err(_) => {
                                // Not a DNS message, might be a regular UDP packet
                                // This is expected for local UDP packets
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        error!("Error receiving on UDP socket: {}", e);
                        sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                    }
                }
            }
        })
    };

    // Main loop: receive UDP packets and send as DNS queries
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65507];
    let mut packet_id_counter = 0u16;
    
    loop {
        match udp_socket.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
            Ok((len, source)) => {
                let data = &buf[..len];
                debug!("Received {} bytes from {}", len, source);

                // Generate packet ID
                let packet_id = packet_id_counter;
                packet_id_counter = packet_id_counter.wrapping_add(1);

                // Store pending request
                {
                    let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                    pending.insert(packet_id, (source, 0));
                }

                // Fragment packet if needed
                let max_chunk = codec.max_payload_per_query();
                let fragments = fragment_packet(data, max_chunk);
                let total_fragments = fragments.len() as u8;

                info!("Fragmenting packet {} into {} fragments", packet_id, total_fragments);

                // Select domain and resolver
                let domain = &config.domains[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.domains.len())];
                let resolver = if config.rotate_resolvers {
                    let mut idx = resolver_index.lock().await;
                    *idx = (*idx + 1) % config.resolvers.len();
                    rotate_resolver(&config.resolvers, *idx)
                } else {
                    &config.resolvers[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.resolvers.len())]
                };

                // Send each fragment as DNS query
                for (fragment_id, fragment_data) in fragments.iter().enumerate() {
                    match codec.encode_to_dns_query(
                        fragment_data,
                        domain,
                        packet_id,
                        fragment_id as u8,
                        total_fragments,
                    ) {
                        Ok(dns_query) => {
                            let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                            if let Err(e) = dns_query.emit(&mut encoder) {
                                error!("Failed to encode DNS query: {}", e);
                                continue;
                            }

                            let query_bytes = encoder.into_bytes();
                            
                            // Send to multiple resolvers (spam)
                            for resolver in &config.resolvers {
                                if let Err(e) = udp_socket.send_to(&query_bytes, resolver).await {
                                    warn!("Failed to send DNS query to {}: {}", resolver, e);
                                } else {
                                    debug!("Sent DNS query fragment {}/{} to {}", 
                                           fragment_id + 1, total_fragments, resolver);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            error!("Failed to encode packet to DNS: {}", e);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Error receiving UDP packet: {}", e);
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
            }
        }
    }

    // This will never be reached, but keep the task alive
    dns_response_task.await?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::Parser;
use dns_tunnel::{
    config::{load_client_config, ClientConfig},
    dns_codec::DnsCodec,
    packet::{fragment_packet, PacketReassembler, TunnelPacket},
    utils::{bind_random_port, get_random_port, rotate_resolver},
};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::Message,
    serialize::binary::{BinDecodable, BinDecoder},
};
use log::{debug, error, info, warn};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::net::UdpSocket;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "dns-tunnel-client")]
#[command(about = "DNS Tunnel Client (Iran side)")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    config: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    local_addr: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    local_port: Option<u16>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    domains: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    resolvers: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(long, default_value = "64")]
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    #[arg(long)]
    no_rotate_resolvers: bool,
    #[arg(long)]
    randomize_local_port: bool,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();

    let args = Args::parse();
    
    let mut config = if let Some(config_path) = args.config {
        load_client_config(Some(config_path.into()))?
    } else {
        ClientConfig::default()
    };

    // Override with CLI args
    if !args.domains.is_empty() {
        config.domains = args.domains;
    }
    if !args.resolvers.is_empty() {
        config.resolvers = args.resolvers
            .iter()
            .map(|r| r.parse())
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .context("Invalid resolver address")?;
    }
    if args.max_subdomain_length > 0 {
        config.max_subdomain_length = args.max_subdomain_length;
    }
    config.rotate_resolvers = !args.no_rotate_resolvers;
    config.randomize_local_port = args.randomize_local_port;

    // Set local UDP port
    let local_port = if config.randomize_local_port {
        get_random_port()
    } else {
        args.local_port.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            config.local_udp.port()
        })
    };
    let local_udp = format!("{}:{}", args.local_addr, local_port)
        .parse()
        .context("Invalid local UDP address")?;

    info!("Starting DNS Tunnel Client");
    info!("Local UDP: {}", local_udp);
    info!("Domains: {:?}", config.domains);
    info!("Resolvers: {:?}", config.resolvers);
    info!("Max subdomain length: {}", config.max_subdomain_length);
    info!("Resolver rotation: {}", config.rotate_resolvers);

    if config.domains.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one domain must be specified");
    }
    if config.resolvers.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one resolver must be specified");
    }

    // Bind local UDP socket
    let udp_socket = UdpSocket::bind(&local_udp)
        .await
        .context("Failed to bind local UDP socket")?;
    info!("Bound to local UDP: {}", local_udp);

    let codec = Arc::new(DnsCodec::new(config.max_subdomain_length));
    let reassembler = Arc::new(Mutex::new(PacketReassembler::new()));
    let pending_requests: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, (SocketAddr, u16)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    let resolver_index = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0usize));

    // Spawn task to receive DNS responses on the same socket
    let udp_socket_for_dns = udp_socket.clone();
    let dns_response_task = {
        let codec = codec.clone();
        let reassembler = reassembler.clone();
        let pending_requests = pending_requests.clone();
        let config = config.clone();
        
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65535];
            
            loop {
                match udp_socket_for_dns.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
                    Ok((len, src)) => {
                        let response_data = &buf[..len];
                        
                        // Try to parse as DNS response first
                        match Message::from_bytes(response_data) {
                            Ok(message) => {
                                match codec.decode_from_dns_response(&message, &config.domains) {
                                    Ok(Some(packet)) => {
                                        let mut reass = reassembler.lock().await;
                                        if let Some(reassembled_data) = reass.add_fragment(packet.clone()) {
                                            // Find the original source
                                            let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                                            if let Some((original_source, _)) = pending.remove(&packet.packet_id) {
                                                // Forward reassembled packet to original source
                                                if let Err(e) = udp_socket_for_dns.send_to(&reassembled_data, original_source).await {
                                                    error!("Failed to send reassembled packet: {}", e);
                                                } else {
                                                    debug!("Sent reassembled packet to {}", original_source);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Ok(None) => {
                                        // Not a tunnel DNS response, ignore
                                    }
                                    Err(e) => {
                                        // Not a tunnel packet, might be regular DNS or UDP
                                        debug!("Not a tunnel DNS response: {}", e);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            Err(_) => {
                                // Not a DNS message, might be a regular UDP packet
                                // This is expected for local UDP packets
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        error!("Error receiving on UDP socket: {}", e);
                        sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                    }
                }
            }
        })
    };

    // Main loop: receive UDP packets and send as DNS queries
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65507];
    let mut packet_id_counter = 0u16;
    
    loop {
        match udp_socket.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
            Ok((len, source)) => {
                let data = &buf[..len];
                debug!("Received {} bytes from {}", len, source);

                // Generate packet ID
                let packet_id = packet_id_counter;
                packet_id_counter = packet_id_counter.wrapping_add(1);

                // Store pending request
                {
                    let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                    pending.insert(packet_id, (source, 0));
                }

                // Fragment packet if needed
                let max_chunk = codec.max_payload_per_query();
                let fragments = fragment_packet(data, max_chunk);
                let total_fragments = fragments.len() as u8;

                info!("Fragmenting packet {} into {} fragments", packet_id, total_fragments);

                // Select domain and resolver
                let domain = &config.domains[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.domains.len())];
                let resolver = if config.rotate_resolvers {
                    let mut idx = resolver_index.lock().await;
                    *idx = (*idx + 1) % config.resolvers.len();
                    rotate_resolver(&config.resolvers, *idx)
                } else {
                    &config.resolvers[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.resolvers.len())]
                };

                // Send each fragment as DNS query
                for (fragment_id, fragment_data) in fragments.iter().enumerate() {
                    match codec.encode_to_dns_query(
                        fragment_data,
                        domain,
                        packet_id,
                        fragment_id as u8,
                        total_fragments,
                    ) {
                        Ok(dns_query) => {
                            let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                            if let Err(e) = dns_query.emit(&mut encoder) {
                                error!("Failed to encode DNS query: {}", e);
                                continue;
                            }

                            let query_bytes = encoder.into_bytes();
                            
                            // Send to multiple resolvers (spam)
                            for resolver in &config.resolvers {
                                if let Err(e) = udp_socket.send_to(&query_bytes, resolver).await {
                                    warn!("Failed to send DNS query to {}: {}", resolver, e);
                                } else {
                                    debug!("Sent DNS query fragment {}/{} to {}", 
                                           fragment_id + 1, total_fragments, resolver);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            error!("Failed to encode packet to DNS: {}", e);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Error receiving UDP packet: {}", e);
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
            }
        }
    }

    // Keep both tasks running
    tokio::select! {
        _ = dns_response_task => {
            error!("DNS response task ended unexpectedly");
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::Parser;
use dns_tunnel::{
    config::{load_server_config, ServerConfig},
    dns_codec::DnsCodec,
    packet::{fragment_packet, PacketReassembler, TunnelPacket},
    utils::{bind_random_port, get_random_port},
};
use hickory_dns::{
    op::Message,
    serialize::binary::{BinDecodable, BinDecoder, BinEncodable, BinEncoder},
};
use log::{debug, error, info, warn};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::net::UdpSocket;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "dns-tunnel-server")]
#[command(about = "DNS Tunnel Server (VPS side)")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    config: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "0.0.0.0")]
    dns_bind_addr: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    dns_port: Option<u16>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    target_udp: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    domains: Vec<String>,
    #[arg(long, default_value = "64")]
    max_subdomain_length: usize,
    #[arg(long)]
    randomize_dns_port: bool,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();

    let args = Args::parse();
    
    let mut config = if let Some(config_path) = args.config {
        load_server_config(Some(config_path.into()))?
    } else {
        ServerConfig::default()
    };

    // Override with CLI args
    if !args.domains.is_empty() {
        config.domains = args.domains;
    }
    if args.max_subdomain_length > 0 {
        config.max_subdomain_length = args.max_subdomain_length;
    }
    config.randomize_dns_port = args.randomize_dns_port;

    // Set DNS bind port
    let dns_port = if config.randomize_dns_port {
        get_random_port()
    } else {
        args.dns_port.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            config.dns_bind.port()
        })
    };
    let dns_bind = format!("{}:{}", args.dns_bind_addr, dns_port)
        .parse()
        .context("Invalid DNS bind address")?;

    // Set target UDP
    let target_udp = if let Some(target) = args.target_udp {
        Some(target.parse().context("Invalid target UDP address")?)
    } else {
        config.target_udp
    };

    info!("Starting DNS Tunnel Server");
    info!("DNS bind: {}", dns_bind);
    info!("Target UDP: {:?}", target_udp);
    info!("Domains: {:?}", config.domains);
    info!("Max subdomain length: {}", config.max_subdomain_length);

    if config.domains.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("At least one domain must be specified");
    }

    // Bind DNS socket
    let dns_socket = UdpSocket::bind(&dns_bind)
        .await
        .context("Failed to bind DNS socket")?;
    info!("Bound to DNS: {}", dns_bind);

    // Create target UDP socket if specified
    let target_socket = if let Some(target) = target_udp {
        Some(UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")
            .await
            .context("Failed to bind target UDP socket")?)
    } else {
        None
    };

    let codec = Arc::new(DnsCodec::new(config.max_subdomain_length));
    let reassembler = Arc::new(Mutex::new(PacketReassembler::new()));
    // Map: packet_id -> (dns_source, query_id)
    let pending_requests: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, (SocketAddr, u16)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    // Map: packet_id -> dns_source (for responses from target)
    let packet_to_dns_source: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, SocketAddr>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));

    // Spawn task to receive UDP responses from target
    if let Some(ref target_sock) = target_socket {
        if let Some(ref target_addr) = config.target_udp {
            let target_sock = target_sock.clone();
            let target_addr = *target_addr;
            let codec = codec.clone();
            let config = config.clone();
            let dns_socket = dns_socket.clone();
            let pending_requests = pending_requests.clone();
            
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65507];
                
                loop {
                    match target_sock.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
                        Ok((len, _src)) => {
                            let data = &buf[..len];
                            debug!("Received {} bytes from target", len);

                            // Find the original DNS query source
                            let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                            
                            // We need to match this response to a request
                            // For simplicity, we'll use the first pending request
                            // In a real implementation, you'd want better matching
                            if let Some((dns_source, query_id)) = pending.values().next().copied() {
                                // Fragment and encode as DNS responses
                                let max_chunk = codec.max_payload_per_query();
                                let fragments = fragment_packet(data, max_chunk);
                                let total_fragments = fragments.len() as u8;
                                
                                let packet_id = rand::thread_rng().gen::<u16>();
                                let domain = &config.domains[rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..config.domains.len())];

                                for (fragment_id, fragment_data) in fragments.iter().enumerate() {
                                    match codec.encode_to_dns_response(
                                        fragment_data,
                                        domain,
                                        packet_id,
                                        fragment_id as u8,
                                        total_fragments,
                                        query_id,
                                    ) {
                                        Ok(dns_response) => {
                                            let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                                            if let Err(e) = dns_response.emit(&mut encoder) {
                                                error!("Failed to encode DNS response: {}", e);
                                                continue;
                                            }

                                            let response_bytes = encoder.into_bytes();
                                            
                                            if let Err(e) = dns_socket.send_to(&response_bytes, dns_source).await {
                                                warn!("Failed to send DNS response: {}", e);
                                            } else {
                                                debug!("Sent DNS response fragment {}/{} to {}", 
                                                       fragment_id + 1, total_fragments, dns_source);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Err(e) => {
                                            error!("Failed to encode response to DNS: {}", e);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            error!("Error receiving from target: {}", e);
                            sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Main loop: receive DNS queries and forward as UDP
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65535];
    
    loop {
        match dns_socket.recv_from(&mut buf).await {
            Ok((len, dns_source)) => {
                let query_data = &buf[..len];
                
                match Message::from_bytes(query_data) {
                    Ok(message) => {
                        match codec.decode_from_dns_query(&message, &config.domains) {
                            Ok(Some(mut packet)) => {
                                // Set the actual source from DNS query
                                packet.source = dns_source;
                                
                                debug!("Decoded DNS query from {}: packet_id={}, fragment={}/{}", 
                                       dns_source, packet.packet_id, packet.fragment_id + 1, packet.total_fragments);

                                // Store pending request
                                {
                                    let mut pending = pending_requests.lock().await;
                                    pending.insert(packet.packet_id, (dns_source, message.id()));
                                }

                                // Reassemble packet
                                let mut reass = reassembler.lock().await;
                                if let Some(reassembled_data) = reass.add_fragment(packet.clone()) {
                                    info!("Reassembled packet {} ({} bytes)", packet.packet_id, reassembled_data.len());

                                    // Forward to target UDP
                                    if let Some(ref target_sock) = target_socket {
                                        if let Some(target_addr) = config.target_udp {
                                            if let Err(e) = target_sock.send_to(&reassembled_data, target_addr).await {
                                                error!("Failed to forward packet to target: {}", e);
                                            } else {
                                                info!("Forwarded packet to {}", target_addr);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        // No target specified, just log
                                        debug!("No target UDP configured, packet would be forwarded here");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            Ok(None) => {
                                // Not a tunnel packet, send empty response
                                let mut response = Message::new();
                                response.set_id(message.id());
                                response.set_message_type(hickory_dns::op::MessageType::Response);
                                response.set_response_code(hickory_dns::rr::RCode::NXDomain);
                                
                                let mut encoder = BinEncoder::new();
                                if response.emit(&mut encoder).is_ok() {
                                    let _ = dns_socket.send_to(&encoder.into_bytes(), dns_source).await;
                                }
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                warn!("Failed to decode DNS query: {}", e);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        warn!("Failed to parse DNS query: {}", e);
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Error receiving DNS query: {}", e);
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
#[tokio::main]

    } else {

    };

    info!("Starting DNS Tunnel Server");
    info!("DNS bind: {}", dns_bind);
    info!("Target UDP: {:?}", target_udp);

    info!("Max subdomain length: {}", config.max_subdomain_length);

    }

        .await
        .context("Failed to bind DNS socket")?;

    // Map: packet_id -> (dns_source, query_id)
    let pending_requests: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u16, (SocketAddr, u16)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    // Map: packet_id -> dns_source (for responses from target)

                            debug!("Received {} bytes from target", len);

                            // Find the original DNS query source using packet_id
                            // We'll use a simple approach: track the most recent packet_id
                            let mut packet_map = packet_to_dns_source.lock().await;
                            
                            // Find the most recent packet (simple FIFO approach)
                            // In production, you'd want better matching based on connection state
                            if let Some((&packet_id, &dns_source)) = packet_map.iter().next() {
                                packet_map.remove(&packet_id);
                                
                                // Use a dummy query_id for response (we'll generate a new one)
                                let query_id = rand::thread_rng().gen::<u16>();
```
